observations: body L1-L9: the end of the quotation of Proclus, begun on p. XXI; each line opens with a guillemet, and from «Nam cum» (L6) to «pentedecagoni» (L8) the quotation is italic. «tia», «rem» and «esse» (L1) print heavily inked.
body L10: a paragraph begins inside the entry.
body L11: «Eudemi» and «Theon Smyrnaeus» are letter-spaced.

body L15-L16: the Greek of Theon: in «ὅ» (twice) the rough breathing and the acute are joined to the ο; the δ of «κδʹ» prints broken, its upper stroke detached like a tilde, and its numeral sign is printed like an apostrophe (transcribed with the Greek numeral sign). A small upright tick after the ή of «ἀλλήλων» (L15), as after the ή of «στοιχειωτής» on p. XXI, is not transcribed. The κ is the open form of this type (ϰ).
body L20-L38: the entry on pp. 167-175 of the first volume, «167-175» bold at the margin. «al-Ḥasan al-Qummī an-Naysābūrī» is letter-spaced; «Niẓām ad-dīn» is not.

body L21: the i of «tafsīr» and the last i of «aṭ-Ṭabarī» carry short macrons (1.7 and 2.2 by 1.0 pt), as on p. XXI; the last i of «Qorāni» has a round dot (1.4 pt). The f of «tafsīr» prints without its crossbar, like a long s.

body L24-L38: the quotation of an-Naysābūrī, each line opening with a guillemet; the miles and the other insertions in square brackets are Nallino's, and the miles are three times the parasangs throughout. The omissions are marked by five spaced dots. The signs = are printed long (9.7-11.8 pt).
body L28: «منتهاه» and «طرفه» stand inside the Latin parentheses, as printed.
body L33: «al-Qatā» is printed without a dot under the t; «aṣ-Ṣīn» (twice) has the dots under the s and the S. The o of «regiones» prints broken.
body L37: «al-Ǵalāliqah» has the acute above the G and the macron on the second a.
body L16, L29, L31: the dashes measure 10.1-10.3 pt.

notes_left L1-L8, notes_right L1-L8: five notes in two columns with a thin rule between them; note 3 runs from the left column into the right. «Theonis Smyrnaei», «Suter», «Brockelmann», «Quṭb», «ad-dīn ash-Shīrāzī» and «Qāḍī-zādeh» are letter-spaced.

notes_left L1-L6: the Greek of Proclus (note 1) and of Theon (note 2). The smooth breathing of «’Εγγράψαντες» (notes_left L3) is printed before the capital, like an apostrophe; the δ of «πεντεκαιδεκάγωνον» (notes_left L4) prints broken; a small upright tick after the ή of «ἀλλήλων» (notes_left L6) is not transcribed. The κ is the open form of this type.
notes_right L2: the sign = is printed long (7.9 pt); the dash measures 6.9 pt.
notes_right L8: the i of «ad-dīn» and the last i of «Qāḍī-zādeh» carry short macrons (1.6 and 1.8 by 0.8-1.0 pt).
